_readme: PRE-EXISTING schema defects in baseline function bodies, recorded so the
guard fails on anything NEW while keeping these visible.
These are NOT suppressed because they are acceptable. Every entry is a real
42703 or 23502 that fires when the function runs. They are listed rather
than fixed because six of the eight sit inside the FROZEN PAYMENT DOMAIN,
where the standing instruction is to report and not modify.
Fixing one means: repair it in a forward migration, add a regression test,
then DELETE its entry here. Never delete an entry to make the guard quiet.

1482.defect: INSERT INTO conversations (job_id, client_id, inspector_id) — conversations has no inspector_id, and kind/user_id are NOT NULL with no default
1482.impact: accepting an offer via this function would 42703. The live hire path goes through admin_dispatch_job / applications, so reachability is unconfirmed.
1482.status: NOT FIXED — non-payment, fixable, caller reachability to be confirmed first

7431.defect: INSERT INTO organizations (name, kind, owner_id, is_active) omits slug, which is NOT NULL with no default
7431.impact: 23502 whenever this RPC runs. Organizations DO exist and are reachable in the deployed Admin UI, so orgs are evidently created by another path — this particular RPC is the broken one.
7431.status: NOT FIXED — non-payment, fixable; needs caller trace before repair

11099.defect: references wallets.frozen_balance, which does not exist
11099.status: REPORTED ONLY — frozen payment domain, awaiting explicit direction

11835.defect: INSERT INTO transactions (wallet_id, ...) — transactions has no wallet_id; user_id (NOT NULL) not supplied
11835.impact: cancellation bookkeeping raises 42703 at the moment it runs

11944.defect: INSERT INTO transactions (wallet_id, net_amount, fee_amount, ...) — none of the three exist; user_id (NOT NULL) not supplied

11959.defect: second INSERT site, same transactions.wallet_id defect

16413.defect: INSERT INTO audit_events (event_kind, payload) — real columns are event_type/metadata; subject_table, subject_id and summary are NOT NULL and unsupplied
16413.impact: milestone release raises 42703 on its AUDIT write. The defect itself is not monetary, but the function is squarely inside the frozen domain.

21231.defect: INSERT INTO transactions omits amount and type, both NOT NULL with no default
